provenance: Traced shapes regenerate from their own GRAPH_TRACE snapshots (single_0spark, dual_0spark) with scripts/dev/graph-prewarm-from-trace.py; a traced shape's base is the per-device sum of its selected prewarm identities' measured capture bytes, including startup-only siblings, deduplicated by identity and rounded once to 2 MiB; selection ranks by replayed hits only, so a zero-hit startup shape is never selected and a captured-but-never-replayed identity stays lazy. Extra is the fixed 2 MiB capture headroom; the shared graph reserve extra adds room for runtime captures. Untraced (single_sparks, dual_sparks) keeps the bootstrap reserve above and prewarms the 682-shape bootstrap startup set at launch with a warning; an untraced shape never borrows another shape's list.
